clips.title: Steadying a concrete cap by hand
clips.creator: U.S. Navy / Defense VI Records Center
clips.description: A worker in a hard hat rests a gloved hand on a crane-suspended concrete cap and steers it beside a masonry wall as the crane lowers it, then leans over the wall to watch it go down.
